experimental_design.name: Research questions / hypotheses
experimental_design.description: Section 6 has no pre-numbered research questions or preregistered hypotheses; task order operationally follows synthetic accuracy, peptide/conformer applications, manifold demonstration and NFE discussion.

experimental_design.name: Synthetic targets
experimental_design.description: DW-4, LJ-13 and LJ-55 energy benchmarks; target reward is r(x)=-E(x).

experimental_design.name: Synthetic baselines and architecture
experimental_design.description: PIS, DDS, iDEM, AS and ASBS; all methods use a 5-layer EGNN, with a 10-layer Flow Sampling XL variant.

experimental_design.name: Synthetic randomness and metrics
experimental_design.description: Geometric W2 and energy-histogram W2 against long-run MCMC; Table 1 reports mean and standard error across 5 training runs.

experimental_design.name: Synthetic hyperparameters
experimental_design.description: Table 4 reports EGNN layers, adaptive gamma, 10,000 buffer, samples per outer iteration, batch size, 5,000 epochs, iterations/epoch, learning rate and clipping.

experimental_design.name: Peptide task
experimental_design.description: Ala2 (22 atoms) and Ala4 (42 atoms) in full-atom Cartesian coordinates with OpenMM classical force field and implicit water.

experimental_design.name: Peptide metrics and comparison
experimental_design.description: Ala2 compares Flow Sampling and ASBS using 1D DKL, joint JSD and energy W2; Ala4 uses a qualitative torsion-coordinate mode-coverage/concentration study.

experimental_design.name: Peptide uncertainty convention
experimental_design.description: Table 2 prints ± values but does not identify its aggregation unit, number of runs, or whether it is standard error/deviation; this is uncertain.

experimental_design.name: Large-scale conformer data
experimental_design.description: Train on 24,775 SPICE molecular topologies; evaluate 80 held-out SPICE and 80 GEOM-DRUGS molecules.

experimental_design.name: Large-scale model and budget
experimental_design.description: A 12-layer, hidden-128 EGNN; Appendix C gives 8 GPUs, per-GPU buffer 64,000, 128×8 new molecules per iteration, batch 64/GPU, 5,000 outer iterations and 100 replay batches.

experimental_design.name: Large-scale metrics
experimental_design.description: COV recall/precision and AMR with threshold 1.25 Å; Table 3 reports standard deviation across test molecules.

experimental_design.name: Manifold target
experimental_design.description: S2 mixture of evenly weighted vMF components whose means lie along coordinate axes and diagonal directions.

experimental_design.name: Manifold evaluation budget / metric
experimental_design.description: PDF does not report K, concentrations, training budget, numerical metric or baseline for the S2 experiment; values are uncertain rather than inferred.

experimental_design.name: Leakage control and failure criterion
experimental_design.description: Held-out SPICE and GEOM-DRUGS generalization labels are stated, but split-generation protocol, leakage audit and preregistered failure criterion are absent.

experimental_design.name: Implementation provenance
experimental_design.description: The PDF provides PyTorch-style pseudocode but no code URL, commit, environment manifest, seed values or GPU model.

result_inventory.claim: Flow Sampling has the lowest reported energy-histogram W2 among learned methods on the three synthetic targets.
result_inventory.comparison: ASBS: 0.20±0.11, 1.99±1.01, 28.10±8.15; Table 1 also includes PIS, DDS, iDEM, AS and ground-truth subsets.
result_inventory.statistical_method: mean ± standard error across 5 training runs; no hypothesis test.
result_inventory.author_interpretation: Outperforms prior methods and improves low-energy concentration.
result_inventory.alternative_explanation: LJ-13 geometric W2 difference versus ASBS is small; no formal significance test.

result_inventory.claim: On Ala2, Flow Sampling has materially lower listed divergences than ASBS at NFE 1024 and remains finite at NFE 64.
result_inventory.statistical_method: ± values reported but aggregation semantics and repeat count are uncertain.
result_inventory.author_interpretation: Flow Sampling degrades more gracefully as NFE decreases.
result_inventory.alternative_explanation: Metrics use a particular MD reference and the source of Table 2 uncertainty is unspecified.

result_inventory.claim: Flow Sampling visually covers all eight Ala4 torsional modes seen in the MD reference.
result_inventory.comparison: Figure 3 compares ASBS, Flow Sampling and MD.
result_inventory.statistical_method: No numeric metric, denominator or uncertainty shown.
result_inventory.author_interpretation: Samples are more tightly concentrated in MD-supported regions.
result_inventory.alternative_explanation: A three-panel plot cannot quantify density error or demonstrate generalization.

result_inventory.claim: On SPICE, Flow Sampling recall COV remains near 90 across 256/128/64 train NFE.
result_inventory.comparison: AS recall COV falls from 88.60±20.83 to 29.13±–; ASBS is reported at 512 NFE.
result_inventory.statistical_method: standard deviation across test molecules; N=80 test molecules.
result_inventory.alternative_explanation: A test-molecule SD does not isolate run-to-run training variation.

result_inventory.claim: GEOM-DRUGS supports low-NFE stability but does not show uniform metric dominance.
result_inventory.statistical_method: standard deviation across test molecules; ASBS precision not reported.
result_inventory.author_interpretation: Flow Sampling remains robust across metrics at reduced NFE.
result_inventory.alternative_explanation: Cross-method NFE budgets differ and GEOM metric winners vary.

result_inventory.claim: The Riemannian implementation recovers a spherical vMF mixture in the presented illustration.
result_inventory.author_interpretation: Flow Sampling operates directly on curved geometry without reparameterization.
result_inventory.alternative_explanation: The shown evidence is only S2; hyperbolic spaces and quantitative fidelity are not tested.

claim_closure.claim: Learn a sampler from an unnormalized density without target data samples.
claim_closure.method_response: Eqs. (13)–(23) define source-conditioned denoising drift and fixed-point objective.
claim_closure.evidence_response: Synthetic, peptide and conformer experiments use energy-defined targets.
claim_closure.conclusion_response: Conclusion restates matching conditional denoising drift.

claim_closure.claim: Reuse endpoint energy gradients to reduce evaluation cost.
claim_closure.method_response: Proposition 3.2 and Algorithm 1 pair endpoint samples with one score in a replay buffer.
claim_closure.evidence_response: Tables 2–3 compare low-NFE regimes and p9 decomposes cost.

claim_closure.claim: Derive a closed-form conditional drift on constant-curvature manifolds.
claim_closure.method_response: Proposition 4.1 and Eqs. (32)–(44) give Jacobian, score correction and sphere instantiation.
claim_closure.conclusion_response: Conclusion repeats the constant-curvature formula claim.

claim_closure.claim: Empirically validate non-Euclidean sampling beyond Euclidean space.
claim_closure.method_response: Manifold drift is instantiated on S2.
claim_closure.evidence_response: Figure 1 and Section 6.4 show one vMF mixture on S2.
Table 1 reports 5-run mean ± SE across three targets and two metrics.

claim_closure.claim: Scale to amortized conformer generation with 4–8× lower simulation-training cost.
claim_closure.method_response: Conditional molecular drift and low-NFE exploration configuration are specified.
claim_closure.evidence_response: Table 3 gives NFE/quality tradeoffs; p9 calls 8× exploration reduction potential.

claim_closure.claim: The fixed-point replay-buffer procedure converges globally.

claim_closure.method_response: Uses detached endpoint approximation and alternating replay-buffer updates.
claim_closure.evidence_response: No convergence experiment or theorem supplied.
claim_closure.conclusion_response: Explicitly says no global convergence guarantee.

limitations.name: Fixed-point convergence
limitations.description: Ideal conditional diffusion-matching uses unavailable target samples and is approximated with detached sampler endpoints; no global convergence guarantee for replay-buffer dynamics.

limitations.name: Riemannian scope
limitations.description: The efficient extension depends on closed-form conditional drifts for constant-curvature manifolds; general manifolds and constrained spaces remain future work.

limitations.name: Downstream deployment
limitations.description: Biases or inaccuracies could influence downstream decisions in drug discovery and materials science.

adverse_presentation_strategies.description: Table 2 retains ASBS 128/64 rows with very large energy W2 and the prose calls them failures; p9 also names AS degradation. This is a positive discussion of unfavorable baseline evidence, not an inference about intent.

adverse_presentation_strategies.name: Cost claim uses an exploration-NFE proxy
adverse_presentation_strategies.description: The 4–8× training-cost wording is supported in detail by NFE to acquire samples and a potential exploration-phase reduction; total wall-clock time is not reported.

adverse_presentation_strategies.name: Manifold empirical evidence is qualitative
adverse_presentation_strategies.description: The S2 claim is supported by Figure 1 and prose without metric, baseline or hyperbolic experiment. This records evidence scope and does not infer case selection intent.

lexical_rhetoric.counting_scope: Case-insensitive raw PDF text p1–p9, including headings/captions and excluding references; used for rhetorical structures, not final aggregate token statistics.
lexical_rhetoric.claim_style: Strong terms are concentrated in abstract/contributions/results; potentially and appears limit the NFE-cost and Ala2 degradation interpretations.

final_judgment.single_storyline: 把依赖 target data sample 的 flow-matching supervision 改写为 source-conditioned denoising path，用 endpoint ∇r 的 closed-form target 与 detached replay buffer 训练 amortized sampler；manifold extension 以 geodesic/Jacobian 重用该逻辑。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 问题定义、conditional path、loss、Algorithm 1、命题陈述、主结果表、NFE discussion 与两条显式 limitations。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: 完整证明、metric definitions、hyperparameters、reference-data details、additional histogram 与 Adjoint Sampling target-law comparison；主文理解足够，严格理论验证与完整复现依赖 appendix。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Figure 2 的路径对照紧接 Proposition 3.2 的 closed-form target，并由 Algorithm 1 固化为 exploration/optimization 操作链。
final_judgment.largest_gap: 4–8× speedup 依赖 NFE/exploration proxy 而非 end-to-end timing；manifold 经验证据仅为 S2 定性图；fixed-point global convergence 明确未给出。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 对昂贵 oracle 的 learned sampler，应在训练 target 中标出 oracle evaluation 的复用位置，并在同一主文表中并列 cost proxy、baseline budget 和低预算质量。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 该规则适用于 endpoint gradients 可缓存且 oracle evaluation 主导成本的设定；若 training, memory, solver stability 或 latency 主导，NFE 不能代表总成本。
